nobodys-watching_en:
1
00:00:13,450 --> 00:00:15,490
Turn it up...

2
00:00:17,150 --> 00:00:20,500

3
00:00:20,550 --> 00:00:24,600

4
00:00:24,650 --> 00:00:28,358
All day long I kept it quiet, kept it neat, kept it small

5
00:00:28,408 --> 00:00:33,000
But the moment I'm alone, I don't care at all

6
00:00:33,050 --> 00:00:37,000
Turn the kitchen light down low

7
00:00:37,050 --> 00:00:40,900
Let the bassline take control

8
00:00:40,950 --> 00:00:44,600
Nobody's watching, so I dance like a fool

9
00:00:44,650 --> 00:00:48,050

10
00:00:48,100 --> 00:00:52,270
The world gets the version that's careful and calm

11
00:00:52,320 --> 00:00:57,200

12

00:01:07,950 --> 00:01:11,867

18

4
